query:
query {
    StorefrontUsers(
        where: {
            _or: [{emailLower: {_eq: "primary@email.com"}}, {emailLower: {_eq: "j.doe@work.com"}}, {emailLower: {_eq: "johnny@personal.com"}}, {phoneNumber: {_eq: "+447883727933"}}, {phoneNumber: {_eq: "+14155552673"}}]
        },
        limit: 5
    ) {
        id
        email
        emailLower
        firstName
        lastName
        phoneNumber
        platformId
        createdAt
        updatedAt
        redactedAt
        smsTransactionalOptIn
        ShippingAddresses(limit: 10) {
                id
                platformId
                firstName
                lastName
                company
                address1
                address2
                city
                province
                country
                zip
                phoneNumber
                doorCode
        }
    }
}
